definition: ProTanto at w: a true base reason is admitted for the true f, the rival g is false, and the reason favours f over g. NetSelects at w: some reason does this for f over g, and no true base member favours g over f at w. SelectedAt w: each true field member is net-selected over each false field member. ProTantoAt w: each has a pro tanto reason instead.
note: One candidate reading of 'selects this outcome over that', stipulated to test it. It contains no necessitation clause: the reason may be true where f is false. See docs/notes/explanatory-symmetry-742.md.
